items.name: T-Rex
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon T-Rex, large head, tiny arms, sharp teeth, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: T-Rex had teeth as long as bananas and could eat up to 500 pounds of meat in one bite!

items.name: Triceratops
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon Triceratops, three horns on head, frill, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Triceratops had three horns and a bony frill to protect its neck from predators like T-Rex.

items.name: Stegosaurus
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon Stegosaurus, plates on back, spiked tail, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Stegosaurus had a brain the size of a walnut, but its spiked tail could swing with great force!

items.name: Pteranodon
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon Pteranodon, large crest on head, long wings, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Pteranodon was a flying reptile with a wingspan as wide as a small airplane, but it had no teeth!

items.name: Plesiosaurus
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon Plesiosaurus, long neck, flippers, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Plesiosaurus swam using four flippers like paddles, and some people think it might be the Loch Ness Monster!

items.name: Velociraptor
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon Velociraptor, feathered, claw on foot, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Velociraptor was actually about the size of a turkey and covered in feathers, not scaly skin!

items.name: Brachiosaurus
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon Brachiosaurus, very long neck, tall body, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Brachiosaurus could reach heights of 40 feet tall, letting it munch on treetops like a giant giraffe!

items.name: Ichthyosaurus
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon Ichthyosaurus, dolphin-like body, fins, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Ichthyosaurus looked like a dolphin but was a reptile, and it gave birth to live young in the water.

items.name: Ankylosaurus
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon Ankylosaurus, armored body, club tail, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Ankylosaurus had a club on its tail that could smash bones, and its body was covered in bony armor!

items.name: Archaeopteryx
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon Archaeopteryx, feathered wings, claws, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Archaeopteryx is the missing link between dinosaurs and birds, with feathers and teeth!

items.name: Mosasaurus
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon Mosasaurus, long body, flippers, sharp teeth, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Mosasaurus was a giant marine lizard that could grow longer than a school bus and ate fish and sharks!

items.name: Diplodocus
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon Diplodocus, extremely long neck and tail, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Diplodocus had a tail so long it could crack like a whip, making a loud sound to scare predators!

items.name: Pterodactylus
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon Pterodactylus, pointed beak, wings, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Pterodactylus was a small flying reptile that ate fish and insects, and its name means 'wing finger'.

items.name: Crocodile
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon crocodile, long snout, scaly skin, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Crocodiles are living dinosaurs' cousins and have been around for over 200 million years!

items.name: Shark
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon shark, dorsal fin, sharp teeth, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Sharks have been swimming in the oceans for over 400 million years, even before dinosaurs!

items.name: Dimetrodon
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon Dimetrodon, sail on back, lizard-like body, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Dimetrodon was not a dinosaur but a mammal-like reptile with a sail to warm up in the sun!

items.name: Mammoth
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon mammoth, long curved tusks, furry body, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Mammoths had thick fur and tusks that could be 15 feet long, and they lived during the Ice Age!

items.name: Saber-Toothed Tiger
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon saber-toothed tiger, long fangs, muscular body, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Saber-toothed tigers had canine teeth up to 7 inches long, perfect for stabbing prey!

items.name: Dragonfly (Meganeura)
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon giant dragonfly, large wings, big eyes, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Meganeura was a giant dragonfly with a wingspan of 2.5 feet, as big as a pigeon!

items.name: Ginkgo Tree
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon ginkgo tree, fan-shaped leaves, trunk, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Ginkgo trees have been around since the time of dinosaurs and are still alive today!

items.name: Turtle
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon turtle, shell, flippers, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Turtles have been on Earth for over 200 million years, and some can live for more than 100 years!

items.name: Lizard
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon lizard, four legs, long tail, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Lizards are modern relatives of dinosaurs and can regrow their tails if they lose them!

items.name: Coelacanth
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon coelacanth, lobed fins, blue scales, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Coelacanths were thought to be extinct for 66 million years until one was caught alive in 1938!

items.name: Fern
items.imagePrompt: Cute cartoon fern, green fronds, curly leaves, flat vector art, bright colors, white background, for children
items.funFact: Ferns are ancient plants that were food for many dinosaurs and still grow in forests today!
